44.547Z] [world] Rain the color of old oil. It pools on Aetherstone and refuses to soak in.

You are at Reclaimer's Stake. A Reclaimers' Guild salvage-stake driven into the frontier mud: claim-posts, a tally-board of marked ruins, and a winch rig for hauling up whatever the wastes give. The expedition launches from here.

There is a smell of cold paper, though no books remain.

[2026-08-28T22:27:44.549Z] [world] You think back to the shelf from earlier — the salvage you pulled from it. Something here reminds you of it.
[2026-08-28T22:27:44.554Z] [arbiter] "Nine Cores, nine Guardians, nine Lost Capitals. That's the road. Tap MAIN QUEST to start."

[2026-08-28T22:27:49.252Z] [world] You work the barrel over. A part of it comes loose, intact.
[2026-08-28T22:27:49.252Z] [world] You break the cart apart. Among the pieces, something worth keeping.
[2026-08-28T22:27:49.252Z] [world] Tucked inside the cold spring: an oddment that matches no quartermaster's list. The kind of thing that fuses well.
[2026-08-28T22:27:49.252Z] [world] You break the marker apart. Among the pieces, something worth keeping.
[2026-08-28T22:27:49.253Z] [world] You salvage the rusted toppled obelisk fragment. The take is small but real.
[2026-08-28T22:27:49.253Z] [world] Wedged into the zharak's teeth spire, half-hidden by the dust: a sealed letter. You pocket it carefully.
[2026-08-28T22:27:49.253Z] [world] Already worked over: stone marker.
